what: Monument of Stefan Czarniecki on Plac Czarnieckiego in Tykocin (sandstone, 1762): stone parts of the monument - stepped base, plain block, waisted baroque pedestal with cartouches, figure with the gilt mace.
frame: x = figure's right, y = forward (front of the figure), z = up from the paving at the centre of the base; metres

Reference only (Data/raw/refs/tykocin-rynek-commons, outside git): proportions and layout were read off the photos; no pixel, scan or photogrammetry of them is used.
status: All sizes WORKING_VALUE: no survey of the monument; heights estimated against the fence (about 1.25 m) and the houses (ADR 0320), proportions from the photos (perspective from below, +-10 %).

figure.pose: stands frontally, head turned to his right towards the mace; right arm stretched forward-right about horizontally with the gilt mace (bulawa) held upright, forearm in a dark green vambrace; left hand on the sabre hilt at the hip; knee-length belted zupan, fur-lined delia open at the front and thrown back over the right arm; long beard, bare head; helmet at the left foot

omitted: inscriptions of the pedestal panels and of the band, heraldry of the cartouches (blank shields), buttons smaller than 15 mm, fingers
